source.title: Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1955, p. 3 ("Kilkeel Rural District Council Nominations: Contests in Ballymartin and Glassdrumman")
source.publisher: Newry Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: 'Unopposed' in the Returning Officer's nominations list, read on the page image (Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1955, p. 3)

note: Triennial election of the seventeen electoral divisions of Kilkeel rural district, one member each, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. Two divisions were contested, Ballymartin and Glassdrumman; the other fifteen were returned unopposed (Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1955, p. 3). Returned unopposed.
